title: Graphic Designer/ Receptionist
description:
Role & responsibilities ( Graphic Designer) 
 Create posters, banners, and promotional designs. Design social media posts and advertisements. Edit images and prepare creative designs as required. Work on different design projects as per client requirements. Complete assigned work within deadlines. 
 Preferred candidate profile ( Graphic Designer) 
 Must have basic knowledge of graphic designing software. Should be creative and have a good sense of design. Must be able to create posters, banners, and other designs. Should be able to complete work on time. 
 Role & responsibilities ( Receptionist) Welcome and assist customers visiting the office. Attend phone calls and respond to customer enquiries. Maintain basic records and customer details. Handle emails and other office-related work. Coordinate with staff and manage front desk activities. Preferred candidate profile ( Receptionist) 
 Must have good communication skills. Should be polite and friendly while dealing with customers. Must have basic computer knowledge. Should be punctual, responsible, and well-organized. Freshers can also apply. Communication Skills, Basic Computer Knowledge, Customer Handling, Telephone Handling, Email Handling, Time Management are needed. Salary: 8,000 to 10,000 per month. 
 Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM 
 CONTACT DETAILS - 7587403020 ( ANMOL JHA)

Key Skills: Communication Skills,Graphic Designing,Banner Designing,Canva,Corel Draw,Customer Interaction,Image Editing,Telephone Handling
